notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): relay agent communication cards, handoff chips and background agent context
notes.summary: Browser gateway relay now shows agent communication cards, handoff chips, and background agent prompts and routing reasons on remote surfaces, negotiated through a new additive transcript-agent-context-v1 feature.

notes.subject: fix(tools): stop find_and_replace globs editing git-ignored files
notes.summary: find_and_replace globs now skip git-ignored files in VS Code (with an include_ignored opt-in and ignored_files_skipped reporting), and the CLI and Assistant glob walk refuses over-limit globs instead of editing a partial set.

notes.subject: fix(tools): give Git chains pre-launch guidance and let scoped research write
